findings.message: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption / Memory DoS (CWE-770): Allocating buffers or lists directly proportional to an unvalidated user-controlled count/size parameter allows attackers to trigger memory exhaustion by passing negative or huge values. Enforce strict lower and upper bounds on requested sizes before allocation.
